# 21st.dev Adapter
Canonical service: `https://21st.dev/`.

Use 21st.dev for targeted component discovery when an existing component can reduce unnecessary custom work. Inspect the selected component, its dependencies, author/source information, and project compatibility before adoption. Never claim a component was copied, installed, rendered, or visually verified unless that action actually occurred.

Prefer the smallest compatible component and preserve the project's existing design system.

State: `LIVE_WEB_ADAPTER`.
